kultivator.sects.meditation_bonus: Meditating beside your sect mate %s, your qi flows more smoothly (cultivation ×1.15).
kultivator.sects.help.header: Sect Fellowship (/sect or /sekte): a group of players. A sect with disciples is founded with the Hall Stele.
kultivator.sects.help.create: /sect create <name> – form a Sect Fellowship with other players and become its head
kultivator.sects.help.invite: /sect invite <player> – invite a player as a fellow (head only, valid 5 minutes)
kultivator.sects.help.join: /sect join <name> – join a fellowship that invited you
kultivator.sects.help.leave: /sect leave – leave your fellowship (a head hands it to the oldest fellow)
kultivator.sects.help.disband: /sect disband – dissolve your fellowship (head only, repeat to confirm)
kultivator.sects.help.info: /sect info [name] – about your fellowship or another one
kultivator.sects.help.list: /sect list – every fellowship of this world
kultivator.sects.help.chat: /sect chat <message> – speak to your online fellows
kultivator.sects.help.spar: /sect spar <player> – challenge someone nearby to a friendly sparring match
kultivator.sects.help.spar_answer: /sect spar accept | decline – answer a sparring challenge
kultivator.sects.help.footer: Click a line to put the command into the chat box. Meditating near a fellow gives ×1.15 cultivation. NPC disciples, the Hall and Sect Life live at the Hall Stele (hub › SEKTE).
